verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, but the evidence describes only DeepInfra-hosted options: serverless inference, dedicated private instances, and rented GPU clusters with SSH access. Nothing shows customers running the DeepInfra platform on their own infrastructure. Dedicated instances and GPU rentals are adjacent hosted offerings, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
